'''Deckman''' was the lowest [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. It was equivalent to the rank of [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] in both the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]] and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Enlisted personnel holding the rank of Deckman could be promoted to the rank of [[Senior Deckman]].<ref name="ROE" />
